name: Async handlers sweep: remaining `async def` without await
description:
## Context
P0 (backend responsiveness) removed every *proven* loop blocker: `blocking-call` and `blocking-io` findings of `api/scripts/audit_async_blocking.py` are now **0**, and the hot-path routers (chat, content, analytics, files, file_finder file operations, global_settings, browser deps — 37 handlers) were converted to sync `def` so FastAPI runs them in its threadpool.

What remains are ~25 `async def` handlers **without any `await`** in less-trafficked routers:
`api/db_router.py`, `api/image.py`, `api/knowledge.py`, `api/media.py`, `api/meets.py`, `api/profile_voice.py`, `api/project_search.py`, `api/users.py`, `api/wiki.py`, `api/workspaces.py` (plus the helper `file_finder._get_file_path_for_response`).

## Why it is not purely mechanical
`async def` + no `await` is a **lint**, not proof of blocking. Before converting, read the body:
- **Does disk/network/subprocess work** (reads a file, `requests`, `subprocess`, settings I/O) → convert to `def` so FastAPI offloads it to the threadpool.
- **Pure in-memory / trivial** → leave it `async`; converting adds a threadpool hop for nothing. Do **NOT** convert `api/users.py:proxy_forward_auth` — it is the Traefik forwardAuth probe that runs on *every* proxied request and does no I/O.
- **Never convert a helper** (`file_finder._get_file_path_for_response`) without grepping its callers: an `await helper(...)` caller breaks at runtime with "object is not awaitable".

## Acceptance criteria
- Every remaining finding is either converted to `def` or annotated with a one-line comment explaining why it stays `async` (no I/O).
- `python3 api/scripts/audit_async_blocking.py --strict` exits 0, or the remaining findings are the annotated pure-in-memory ones (then wire a documented allowlist in the script).
- `py_compile` clean on every touched file and every touched router still imports with the app's interpreter (`env PYTHONPATH=api <venv>/python3 -c "import codx.junior.api.<module>"`).
- Smoke-test the affected endpoints (e.g. `GET /api/wiki/...`, `POST /api/workspaces`, media/queue) — these routers have no automated tests, so manual verification is required.

## How to check
```
python3 api/scripts/audit_async_blocking.py            # full report
python3 api/scripts/audit_async_blocking.py --only async-no-await
python3 api/scripts/audit_async_blocking.py --strict   # CI gate
```

## Related
- Test-suite problem found while verifying: `pytest:api` **cannot collect within 300 s** (QA `qa_run_tests` times out before running a single test), and `pytest` is not installed in the `codx-junior-api` image. Any test-driven verification of this card needs that fixed first — treat it as a prerequisite.
